findings.evidence: Lines 486-516 define `matrixOfPoint`, `matrixOfPoint_apply` and `coe_pointToUpperUnitriangular` all `private`, the latter two `@[simp]`; `pointToUpperUnitriangular` (504) is public. Contrast TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GeneralLinear/FunctorOfPoints.lean:65-100, where `matrixOfPoint` is private with no coe-level simp lemma and the public `pointToGeneralLinear_apply` covers all `i j`. In-file proofs already cite `coe_pointToUpperUnitriangular` explicitly (lines 553, 564, 577), so removing/publishing it needs no proof changes.
findings.fix: Make the lemma public with `matrixOfPoint` inlined: `↑↑(pointToUpperUnitriangular R m f) = (genericMatrix R m).map (f.ofConv.comp (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m).toAlgHom)`, and add the unconditional entry lemma `pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply (i j) : ↑↑(pointToUpperUnitriangular R m f) i j = f.ofConv (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m (genericMatrix R m i j))`, mirroring `GeneralLinear.pointToGeneralLinear_apply`; drop `@[simp]` from the conditional `_apply_of_lt` or keep it non-simp.
findings.issue: `coe_pointToUpperUnitriangular` is `private` yet `@[simp]`, so simp rewrites the public term `↑↑(pointToUpperUnitriangular R m f)` into the private constant `matrixOfPoint R m f`; because simp visits that matrix subterm before the application node, the public `pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply_of_lt` (line 519) never fires, and a matrix-level goal is left with an unnameable constant.

summary: The three prior findings (antipode normal form, public extensionality, points naturality) are all fixed, and the surface now mirrors the merged GL coordinate/points modules. One annotation defect remains: a private `@[simp]` coercion lemma rewrites public terms into the private `matrixOfPoint` and shadows the public entry lemma.
